text: This week was flagged due to Allen Cruz McCoy's atypical browsing behavior on leak-publication sites, which is a rare occurrence for someone in his role as a salesman. Specifically, he visited such sites four times this week, which is not something we've seen him do in the past year. While it's normal for him to browse job-search sites (25 visits), visit cloud-storage sites (11 visits), and access various web domains (55 distinct) within typical ranges, his browsing habits on leak-publication sites are unusual.
